An [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] '''sentient species''' with googly-[[Eye/Legends|eyes]] travelled to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They intervened in a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] between an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]] and an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]], mistaking it for a sporting contest.

==Biology and appearance==
The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had google-[[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wet, pulpy knobs that they slapped together to applaud with. The species originated from another [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Night" />

==Society and culture==
The googly-eyed [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] often competed in sporting contests, with some considering themselves to be professional sportsbeings. They would not even consider ruining their reputation and league standing if challenged by those they considered to be amateurs. The species prized fairness in their competitions, and disliked disparity between competitors. Violence was also not condoned.<ref name="Night" />

The species possessed advanced technology, including [[Alien droid|droids]] capable of rendering individuals unconscious with a shimmering light. They operated powerful [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as the [[fathership]]s that were capable of travelling between galaxies. [[Slavery/Legends|Slavery]] was practised by the species, as the losers of sporting contests were often declared to become the slaves of the victors.<ref name="Night" />

==History==
A fathership carrying a number of the aliens entered and toured [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They happened upon a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] between an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]] and an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]]. Misinterpreting the battle as a sporting contest, and being appalled at the mismatch between them, the aliens stunned the two crews and brought them aboard the fathership.<ref name="Night" />

The aliens afforded the two crews the honor of allowing them to continue their sporting contest due to it being one of their feast celebrations. The aliens graciously served as judges at no extra cost, and wanted the Rebel and Imperial crews to compete for their entertainment. The aliens proposed several contests for the crews to compete in, including [[free-style zero-G swimming]], [[acrobatic pyramids]], marksmanship, [[loudest-howling]], and [[zero-G mini-speeder go-cart steeplechase]].<ref name="Night" />

Eventually, the Rebel crew won the contest, and the aliens declared the  Imperial crew to be enslaved to the victors. They offered to return the Rebels to their ships along with their new slaves. However, the aliens declined to become involved in the war, however, as they were heading back to their home galaxy.<ref name="Night" />

==Behind the scenes==
"[[The Night Has a Thousand Eyes]]" is intended to be a light-hearted role-playing adventure, meaning that the googly-eyed species are meant to be played for laughs. The Staging Hints for the mini-adventure state that for a more serious tone, the aliens can be depicted as grim and warlike, and the sporting contests more akin to gladiatorial contests.
